reviewer.metadataNote: Only reviewer metadata actually retained in the original report is used.

snapshot.workingTree: Remediation of the reviewed baseline; no fresh full acceptance claimed.
snapshot.note: Original snapshot metadata; normalization does not constitute a new review. Unknown or abbreviated values are not reconstructed.

scope.note: Original scope and exclusions are preserved; no additional review coverage is claimed.

findings.title: token supply exported as credits
findings.correction: CSV/XLSX token rows leave DASH amount fields empty and preserve token ID, supply and decimals as metadata. JSON remains token-typed.
findings.evidence: Real CSV, generated XLSX XML and JSON assertions in Activity Viewer export tests.

findings.title: Ethereum case duplicates
findings.correction: Canonical address identity is deduplicated before lookup and aggregation.
findings.evidence: One account in different case forms plus a distinct control yields two queries and 2 ETH, not three.

findings.title: Identity history integrity
findings.correction: Summary counts, stable page totals and collection identities are checked. Missing counts are explicitly unverified; bounded results retain display-limit warnings. Scanner transfer summaries use the same integrity guard.
findings.evidence: 150 unique records, overlap, missing/unknown count, changed count, premature end, resource revision duplicate, and legitimate transfer legs.

findings.title: stale cross-query state
findings.correction: Removed retained Bitcoin balance state and retained Platform Explorer synchronization responses. First-party HTTP bypasses browser caching.
findings.evidence: Same service observes 100 then 0 satoshis; a new query rejects a newly unsynchronized Explorer.

findings.title: partial Orchard accounting
findings.correction: Completion context reaches note presentation, section metrics, aggregate, CSV/JSON and seed/public scan status. Unknown balance is nullable; observed note value and known spend remain available.
findings.evidence: Same ledger rendered partial/complete and exported; observed spend stays spent; empty IVK scan remains unavailable; both controller source modes report incomplete.

findings.title: address checksums
findings.correction: Shared Bitcoin Base58Check/witness decoders and Ethereum EIP-55 validation run in UI and network boundary. Complete batch screening precedes networking; detected secrets are erased.
findings.evidence: Corrupted checksum, wrong network, witness version/checksum/length mismatch, uppercase positive control, Ethereum checksum cases and zero-request private-input test.

findings.title: native Rust selection
findings.correction: Native commands explicitly select the pinned installed toolchain with `RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN`.
findings.evidence: Instructions now distinguish installing from selecting the toolchain.

findings.title: documentation drift
findings.correction: Corrected immutable audit metadata description, recorded historical browser acceptance, removed future-bundle wording, and documented current input/completeness/export behavior.

limitations.note: Unknown execution details are not supplied by normalization.

normalization.note: Original results, dates, snapshots and evidence are retained. Null fields mean not recorded, not passed or resolved. No audit commands were re-executed as part of this migration.
